title: Modification of Use Regulations in M1 Districts
previewText: In the Special West Chelsea District, the provisions of Section 42-10 (USE ALLOWANCES), inclusive, are modified to permit, as-of-right, without limitation, in M1 Districts, museums listed under Use Group III.
